ascending_admissibility: Ranking alone does not qualify a current observation. Existing geometry, bilateral, pose, directional brake, transfer and stability qualifications remain required. Unvalidated outcomes are reported as such.
rule: Use a valid currently registered pose. Of two candidates, advance 0 or 4 mm along the horizontal ray from the base through the observed center, with target globally 18 mm above the observed center. Rank by minimum absolute radial distance of the candidate to the 0.450 m nominal reset center of the frozen native XML. A tie selects 0. Never move laterally across the other axis; never alter downstream action target or any qualification, corridor, wrist or command limit.
scoring: Apply the deterministic rule once per new placement using only its camera reference. Compare against the registered 0/10 nominal setting on an independent clone of each same return. No refitting, no fallback to an unsampled candidate on the new four. Full stable completion and original 1 mm corridor remain required. Check original t01/t02 separately using real native camera feedback.
